title: Like the Wind Carries Scent
translation: When the soul takes a body and when it leaves one, it carries these along, as the wind carries scents from their source.
translation_hi: जब जीवात्मा शरीर ग्रहण करता है और जब उसे छोड़ता है, तब इन्हें साथ ले जाता है, जैसे वायु फूलों से सुगंध ले जाती है।
science: The wind really does carry scent: smell is made of tiny molecules that drift through the air from flowers to your nose, where receptors detect them.
